title: Dashboard Live Kanban Improvements
description: Improve the live Kanban dashboard with better UX: ticket detail modal, filter persistence, dark mode support, and mobile-responsive layout.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a ticket card opens detail modal with full metadata
Stage filters persist across page reloads (URL params or localStorage)
Dark mode toggle with system preference detection
Responsive layout works on tablet and mobile screens
SSE reconnection with exponential backoff on disconnect
Loading skeleton while initial snapshot arrives
